mechanism: Chlorthalidone can cause hyponatremia and electrolyte disturbances, which are also associated with SSRIs like sertraline, increasing risk of SIADH and hyponatremia; additionally, thiazide diuretics may increase QT prolongation risk when combined with SSRIs.
action: Monitor serum sodium levels and electrolytes periodically; assess QT interval at baseline; educate patient on hyponatremia symptoms (confusion, headache, seizures); consider alternative antihypertensive if hyponatremia develops.
